Product User Manual

Installation

Follow these steps to install the product:

  1. Download the installer from our website
  2. Run the installer with administrator privileges
  3. Follow the on-screen instructions
  4. Restart your computer when prompted

Getting Started

After installation, launch the application from your desktop shortcut. The first time you run the application, you will be prompted to create an account.

Troubleshooting

Common Issues

If the application fails to start, ensure that your system meets the minimum requirements: Windows 10 or later, 4GB RAM, 2GB free disk space.

Support

For technical support, visit our help center or contact support@product.com.
